jd:
Introduction to the job 
 ASML US, including its affiliates and subsidiaries, bring together the most creative minds in science and technology to develop lithography machines that are key to producing faster, cheaper, more energy-efficient microchips. We design, develop, integrate, market and service these advanced machines, which enable our customers - the world’s leading chipmakers - to reduce the size and increase the functionality of their microchips, which in turn leads to smaller, more powerful consumer electronics. Our headquarters are in Veldhoven, Netherlands and we have 18 office locations around the United States including main offices in Chandler, Arizona, San Jose and San Diego, California, Wilton, Connecticut, and Hillsboro, Oregon.
  
 The Software Engineering Foundation at ASML in Wilton, Connecticut is seeking an intern to work in the  Data Science team.  This internship is during the summer of 2027, lasting approximately 12 weeks.  This position is located on-site in Wilton, CT. It requires onsite presence to attend in-person work-related events, trainings and meetings and to further ensure teamwork, collaboration and innovation. Must be available for for one of these sessions starting with the following dates: 6/2/2027 or 6/14/2027 

 Roles and Responsibilities 
 As an intern in the Data Science team, your responsibilities will include:
 
• Developing solutions utilizing one or more data science or data engineering approaches, such as: 
• Computer vision and image processing algorithms 
• Machine learning methods for optimizing engineering processes/physical components/optical metrology 
• Data pipelines, dashboard and data analysis 
• Large language model (LLM) agent (build and evaluate) 
• Understanding technical requirements and developing solutions that meets them. 
• Documenting and clearly communicating progress, findings, and insights to stakeholders. 
 Education and Experience 
 Currently pursuing a bachelor’s or Master’s or PhD degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Software Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field with at least 2 years of undergraduate study completed; Pursuing a master’s or PhD doctoral degree in one of these fields. 
 
• Experience  in developing software: Python , C/C++, or MATLAB 
• Familiarity with software version management such as Git and code collaboration platforms such as GitHub or Bitbucket. 
• Experience in one of more data science or data engineering areas, such as computer vision, image processing algorithm development, data pipelines, data analysis, machine learning, or building AI agents. 
• A strong foundation through course work in computer science, mathematics, computational physics, or software engineering, with a focus on topics such as computer vision and image processing, data engineering, or machine learning. 
• Demonstrated creativity, initiative, and sound coding practices. 
 Skills 
 Working at the cutting edge of tech, you will always have new challenges and new problems to solve – and working together is the only way do that. You will not work in a silo. Instead, you will be part of a creative, dynamic work environment where you will collaborate with supportive colleagues. There is always space for creative and unique points of view. You will have the flexibility and trust to choose how best to tackle tasks and solve problems.
  
 To thrive in this job, you will need the following skills:

• Must be able to read and interpret data, information, and documents. 
• Results-driven; able to demonstrate ownership, accountability, and commitment to achieving results on time. 
• Ability to identify bottlenecks and drive improvements. 
• Ability to complete assignments with attention to detail and a high degree of accuracy. 
• Ability to respond appropriately to workplace situations and interact effectively with others. 
• Ability to learn and apply new information or skills. 
• Strong customer focus and commitment to customer satisfaction through prioritization, quality, efficiency and professionalism. 
• Proficient in the use of Microsoft Office applications. 
• Ability to work effectively in a demanding environment with changing workloads. 
• Ability to work independently and collaboratively as part of a team and follow through on assignments with minimal supervision. 
• Demonstrate clear, concise and professional written and verbal communication, including effective communication within the team. 
• Ability to establish and maintain cooperative working relationships with managers, co-workers and customers. 
• Demonstrated teamwork, commitment to quality, strong interpersonal skills and a focus on delivering results on time.  
 Other Information 
 
• Routinely required to sit; walk; talk; hear; use hands to keyboard, finger, handle and feel; stoop, kneel, crouch, twist, reach and stretch 
• Occasionally required to move around the campus 
• Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and ability to adjust focus The current base hourly range for this role is currently: 
 $18.00 to $48.00 per hour 
   
 Pay scales are determined by role, level, location and alignment with market data. Individual pay is determined through interviews and an assessment of several factors that that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to job-related skills, relevant education and experience, certifications, abilities of the candidate and pay relative to other team members 
 
 This position may require access to controlled technology, as defined in the Export Administration Regulations (15 C.F.R. § 730, et seq.). Qualified candidates must be legally authorized to access such controlled technology prior to beginning work. Business demands may require the Company to proceed with candidates who are immediately eligible to access controlled technology. 

 Inclusion and diversity 
 ASML is an Equal Opportunity Employer that values and respects the importance of a diverse and inclusive workforce. It is the policy of the company to recruit, hire, train and promote persons in all job titles without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation, or gender identity. We recognize that inclusion and diversity is a driving force in the success of our company.
 
 Need to know more about applying for a job at ASML? Read our frequently asked questions .
fit_why: Computer vision, optical metrology, and ML-heavy; stronger on web/full-stack

In this Role, You Will…:
• Formulate and build statistical and machine learning models to evaluate system performance and analyze rare, high-consequence safety events. 

• Process and analyze large-scale datasets using SQL, Python, or distributed data frameworks (Spark/Databricks) to extract actionable insights on vehicle behavior and operational risk. 

• Apply advanced statistical methods (e.g., Poisson processes, GLMs, Bayesian inference, point process models, or spatial-temporal modeling) to evaluate safety-critical metrics. 

• Collaborate with systems engineers and safety leads to translate complex quantitative models into rigorous mission assurance decisions.

Internship Requirements:
• Currently pursuing a Master's or Ph.D. in Statistics, Data Science, Machine Learning, Computer Science, or a related quantitative engineering/scientific discipline. 

• Enrolled in good academic standing at an accredited college or university throughout the internship. 

• Expected to graduate between Fall 2027 and Summer 2028 . 

• Able to commit to a full-time, 12-week internship beginning in May/June 2027 . 

• Ability to relocate to the Bay Area, California, for the duration of the internship. 

• Interns at Zoox may not use any proprietary information they are working on as part of their thesis, any published work with their university, or to be distributed to anyone outside of Zoox.

Qualifications:
• Statistical Foundations: Deep understanding of probability theory, regression, Generalized Linear Models (GLMs), hypothesis testing, and Bayesian methods. Experience or coursework in spatial statistics, space-time models, point process models, or causal inference. 

• Machine Learning & Modeling: Strong fundamentals in statistical modeling and ML (supervised and unsupervised learning, model validation, and metric evaluation). 

• Data Manipulation & Querying: Proficiency with basic-to-intermediate SQL and Python for data querying, data cleaning, and statistical modeling (or alternative data packages such as Spark, dplyr , or R). 

• Communication & Problem Solving: Demonstrated ability to break down ambiguous operational or system questions into structured statistical problems and clearly communicate complex quantitative findings to technical stakeholders.

Bonus Qualifications:
• Large-Scale Data Processing: Experience querying, pipeline-building, and modeling massive datasets using Spark, Databricks, or cloud platforms. 

• Rare-Event Modeling & Domain Experience: Familiarity with autonomous vehicles, transportation network companies (TNCs), quantitative safety/risk modeling, or fraud/rare-event detection. 

• AI-Assisted Workflow & Tooling: Experience utilizing AI-assisted data analysis, modern coding agents, or LLM-driven research workflows to accelerate data exploration and model development.

About Zoox
Zoox is developing the first ground-up, fully autonomous vehicle fleet and the supporting ecosystem required to bring this technology to market. Sitting at the intersection of robotics, machine learning, and design, Zoox aims to provide the next generation of mobility-as-a-service in urban environments. We’re looking for top talent that shares our passion and wants to be part of a fast-moving and highly execution-oriented team.

Follow us on LinkedIn

Accommodations
If you need an accommodation to participate in the application or interview process please reach out to accommodations@zoox.com or your assigned recruiter.

A Final Note:
You do not need to match every listed expectation to apply for this position. Here at Zoox, we know that diverse perspectives foster the innovation we need to be successful, and we are committed to building a team that encompasses a variety of backgrounds, experiences, and skills.

Join us and assimilate cutting edge tech knowledge at SOTI: Next Gen! 

 Job Title:  Software Developer Intern
 Position Type: Co-op  
 Location:  HQ, ON (Hybrid)
 Temporary, Internship 

 Opportunity  

 SOTI’s growth and success is a result of commitment to innovation through entrepreneurial culture and leadership. Employees are driven to make an impact, offer a unique value and most importantly, be part of a winning team. As a successful candidate, you’ll get the chance to work with leading edge technologies and take on complex and interesting projects as part of fast-paced, highly collaborative and agile teams. 
 
The technologies you learn during an internship at SOTI range from learning to develop middle tier services using languages like C#, or deepening your knowledge of databases by leveraging SQL and learning how to build high performance apps using storage procedures. Depending on the area you work in, you may get an opportunity to learn about technologies such as data analytics, machine learning, fault tolerant computing, building high end scalable solutions, or vision systems.

 What you will learn:  
 
• Enhance your programming skills by working in a team alongside experienced team members  
• Gain an understanding of how various roles work together to deliver software products: Developers, Architects, Quality Assurance, User Experience, Product Management, Software Development, Marketing, etc.  
• Gain an understanding of how user requirements are gathered, and the various processes used to translate real-world problems into software solutions  
• Understand the tools and processes used to develop professional software products e.g. Jira, Git  
• Understand the testing processes and frameworks used to deliver high quality software products  
    Required skills:    
 
• Knowledge of algorithms, data structures and database fundamentals  
• Basic knowledge of Software Development Life Cycle concepts  
• Strong math, analytic and problem-solving skills  
• Basic knowledge of programming in one or more of the following programming languages: C, C++, Java, JavaScript, SQL, Ruby, Rust, Lua, Haskell  
• Most importantly curiosity, a desire to learn and be a part of a team  
 About SOTI  
  
 It all started with a classic story about one developer’s vision. While Carl Rodrigues, President and CEO of SOTI, was an IT consultant, he developed solutions for managing mobile device screens from a desktop. An innovation that has put him ahead in what is now one of the largest growing markets – Enterprise Mobility Management (EMM).  
With a passion for innovation, and a relentless drive for quality, Carl now leads one of the fastest growing, profitable, and self-sustaining companies in Canada, and continues to build on the company’s early lead in the enterprise mobility market. 
 
 Today, more than 17,000 enterprise customers around the world depend on us to secure, manage, and support their mobile operations, with millions of devices managed worldwide. SOTI’s two decades of success has built strong partnerships with leading mobile platform providers and device manufacturers. At SOTI, we have demonstrated commitment to staying at the forefront of mobility management and security. We are deeply committed to researching and developing solutions that address today’s toughest mobility challenges. We strive to go where nobody has gone before. 
 #LI-RJ1

 If you want to bring your ideas to life, apply at SOTI today. 
 
 Use of Artificial Intelligence in Hiring 
 
 SOTI uses AI tools to support parts of our recruitment process, such as reviewing resumes, screening qualifications, and creating interview questions. These tools assist our team only-final hiring decisions are made by people, not automation. For privacy-related questions, please contact privacy@soti.net . 
 
 We are committed to providing accessible employment practices that are in compliance with the requirements under the Human Rights Code and the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act (AODA). If you require accommodation during any stage of the recruitment process, please notify People & Culture at careers@soti.net . growth. Engage! 
 
 Please note that SOTI does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters or employment agencies. In the absence of a signed Services Agreement with agency/recruiter, SOTI will not consider or agree to payment of any referral compensation or recruiter fee.

jd:
Trace la courbe de ta carrière dans notre équipe Investissement Québec 
 
 Choisir Investissement Québec, c’est devenir le partenaire de milliers d’entreprises québécoises et les accompagner dans la réalisation de leurs plus grandes ambitions. C’est aussi tracer la courbe de ta carrière avec une équipe fière et engagée.

 2 postes à combler 

 Mandat : 
 
Vous contribuerez à bâtir l'infrastructure opérationnelle de l'équipe d'investissement. Elle vise à réduire le travail manuel et à libérer du temps pour l'analyse, les transactions et le suivi des sociétés en portefeuille. Vous serez responsable et impliqué dans des projets concrets, de la conception jusqu'au transfert à l'équipe. Chaque projet est supervisé par un membre de l'équipe qui en valide les besoins et les résultats.

 Rôle et responsabilités : 

• Structurer l'information : concevoir et appliquer des conventions de nomenclature et des arborescences SharePoint standardisées pour les dossiers transactionnels et de portefeuille. 
• Bâtir des registres et des outils de suivi : consolider les données sur les sociétés, les contacts et les documents dans des répertoires et des classeurs Excel structurés, avec des contrôles de qualité. 
• Extraire et valider des données contractuelles : relever, dans des documents juridiques et financiers, des éléments clés (droits d'information, échéances, gouvernance) et les valider avec l'équipe. 
• Automatiser des tâches répétitives : développer des flux Power Automate (classement de courriels et de documents, alertes d'échéances, suivi de demandes périodiques). 
• Prototyper des usages de Copilot : concevoir, tester et documenter des prompts et des agents qui accélèrent la recherche, l'analyse et la production de livrables. 
• Tester avec les utilisateurs : mener des essais sur des cas réels, consigner les écarts et itérer. 
• Documenter et transférer : produire la documentation, les gabarits et la formation nécessaires pour que chaque solution reste utilisable après votre départ.   
 Profil recherché : 

• Étudiant(e) à [baccalauréat / maîtrise] en [génie logiciel, informatique, systèmes d'information, TI de gestion, finance, ou domaine connexe] . 
• Maîtrise d'Excel et aisance avec l'écosystème Microsoft 365 (SharePoint, Power Automate, Outlook, Teams). 
• Rigueur, souci du détail et capacité à structurer des données. 
• Autonomie, sens de l'initiative et capacité à livrer des versions fonctionnelles dans des délais courts. 
• Bonne communication écrite et orale en français; anglais fonctionnel.   
 Atouts : 

• Expérience avec Copilot, les LLM ou l'ingénierie de prompts. 
• Notions de Power Apps, Power BI, Python, VBA ou Office Scripts. 
• Intérêt pour la finance, le capital de risque ou le droit des affaires. 
• Expérience de travail avec de la documentation juridique ou financière.   
 Ce que nous offrons : 

• Un mandat concret avec un impact direct sur l'efficacité d'une équipe d'investissement institutionnelle. 
• Un encadrement structuré : un responsable désigné et un suivi hebdomadaire. 
• Une exposition au capital de risque, aux transactions et à la gouvernance de sociétés en portefeuille  
 Salaire : 20,87 $ à 30,93 $ de l’heure selon le niveau de scolarité.
fit_why: Power Automate, SharePoint, Excel focus; French-required; little SWE overlap

Job Description: 
 
 DataRobot delivers AI that maximizes impact and minimizes business risk. Our platform and applications integrate into core business processes so teams can develop, deliver, and govern AI at scale. DataRobot empowers practitioners to deliver predictive and generative AI, and enables leaders to secure their AI assets. Organizations worldwide rely on DataRobot for AI that makes sense for their business — today and in the future.  

 Our interns are not observers—they are contributors. Embedded in real teams and paired with dedicated mentorship, you will work on practical problems and deliver meaningful engineering output.

 In this role, you will partner closely with our Documentation and Engineering teams to improve our developer-facing documentation platform, build CI/CD automation, and apply modern AI tooling to maintain freshness and accuracy. You will focus on building tools that minimize manual overhead—such as PR checks, content validation pipelines, and release workflows—helping our documentation evolve seamlessly alongside our product.

 This is a fully remote position open to recent college graduates and early-career engineers. The program runs approximately 6 months.

 What you'll do: 

• Build CI/CD Checks & Workflow Automation: Develop lightweight GitHub Actions/PR checks to streamline doc reviews, run automated linters, and validate content changes against code updates. 
• Automate Testing & Code Snippet Execution: Create automated tests that run documentation code examples and notebooks in CI to catch breaking changes early. 
• Implement Content & Documentation Tooling: Assist in building tools and scripts to convert, generate, or publish documentation artifacts (e.g., Markdown/MDX pipelines, changelogs, and release summaries from Jira/PR data). 
• Apply AI to Developer Tooling: Explore using LLMs and agentic scripts for practical site health tasks, such as flagging stale screenshots or enhancing doc indexing and retrieval for AI assistants. 
• Collaborate & Document: Work closely with your mentor and docs engineers, communicate progress in weekly syncs, and present your accomplishments at the end-of-internship Showcase. 
 What you'll learn: 

• CI/CD & Developer Productivity: Practical experience building GitHub workflows, PR bots, and test automation pipelines in a large-scale engineering environment. 
• Modern Documentation Engineering: Hands-on experience with modern documentation frameworks (Markdown, MDX, static site generators) and API documentation lifecycles. 
• Pragmatic AI & LLM Automation: How to apply LLMs, scripting, and evaluation to automate real-world maintenance tasks. 
• Collaborative Software Engineering: Working in an async-first culture using Git, code reviews, Slack, and agile delivery practices. 
 Program Structure: 

 Phase I (Month 1) — Onboarding & Foundation: Learn the platform, toolchains, and repos. Co-create an Individual Learning Plan with your mentor and complete your first guided tickets.
 Phase II (Months 2–5) — Core Project Delivery: Take ownership of scoped automation projects (e.g., CI testing of doc snippets, PR review gating, or generator scripts) with ongoing guidance and weekly 1:1 check-ins.
 Phase III (Month 6) — Refinement, Handoff & Showcase: Finalize deliverables, write clean documentation for the team to maintain your work, and present your accomplishments at an Intern Showcase.

 Qualifications: 

• Recent graduate or completed Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, or a related field (or equivalent practical project experience). 
• Solid foundational programming skills in Python and comfort with scripting or data parsing. 
• Familiarity with Git and GitHub workflows (branching, pull requests, code reviews). 
• Basic exposure to or enthusiasm for CI/CD concepts (e.g., GitHub Actions) and web/documentation formats (Markdown, HTML/CSS, or JavaScript/TypeScript). 
• Curiosity and eagerness to experiment with LLM APIs for developer productivity. 
• Strong written communication skills and an organized, problem-solving mindset. 
 Nice to Have: 

• Experience writing GitHub Actions or automating developer workflows. 
• Prior experience with static site generators (Docusaurus, MkDocs, Next.js, etc.) or MDX. 
• Familiarity with running automated tests or linting tools in CI pipelines. 
• Personal or academic projects integrating LLM APIs (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, or open-source models). 
 The talent and dedication of our employees are at the core of DataRobot’s journey to be an iconic company. We strive to attract and retain the best talent by providing competitive pay and benefits with our employees’ well-being at the core. Here’s what your benefits package may include depending on your location and local legal requirements: Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance, Flexible Time Off Program, Paid Holidays, Paid Parental Leave, Global Employee Assistance Program (EAP) and more! 

 DataRobot Operating Principles: 
 
• Wow Our Customers 
• Set High Standards 
• Be Better Than Yesterday 
• Be Rigorous 
• Assume Positive Intent 
• Have the Tough Conversations 
• Be Better Together 
• Debate, Decide, Commit 
• Deliver Results 
• Overcommunicate 
 Research shows that many women only apply to jobs when they meet 100% of the qualifications while many men apply to jobs when they meet 60%. At DataRobot we encourage ALL candidates, especially women, people of color, LGBTQ+ identifying people, differently abled, and other people from marginalized groups to apply to our jobs, even if you do not check every box. We’d love to have a conversation with you and see if you might be a great fit.  
 
 DataRobot is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. DataRobot is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with physical and mental disabilities. Please see the United States Department of Labor’s EEO poster and EEO poster supplement for additional information. 

 Use of Artificial Intelligence in Our Hiring Process 

 DataRobot uses approved AI-powered tools to support the hiring process in selected regions. These tools may assist in writing job descriptions, reviewing applications, assessing qualifications, and evaluating candidate materials. All decisions regarding applications are made by members of the DataRobot team.

 All applicant data submitted is handled in accordance with our Applicant Privacy Policy .
fit_why: Strong fit: Python, CI/CD, GitHub Actions, LLM APIs, docs tooling, all matching

DataVisor is the world’s leading AI-powered Fraud and Risk Platform that delivers the best overall detection coverage in the industry. With an open SaaS platform that supports easy consolidation and enrichment of any data, DataVisor's solution scales infinitely and enables organizations to act on fast-evolving fraud and money laundering activities in real time. Its patented unsupervised machine learning technology, advanced device intelligence, powerful decision engine, and investigation tools work together to provide guaranteed performance lift from day one. DataVisor's platform is architected to support multiple use cases across different business units flexibly, dramatically lowering total cost of ownership, compared to legacy point solutions. DataVisor is recognized as an industry leader and has been adopted by many Fortune 500 companies across the globe.
 Our award-winning software platform is powered by a team of world-class experts in big data, machine learning, security, and scalable infrastructure. Our culture is open, positive, collaborative, and results-driven. Come join us!
 
 What You’ll Do 
 
• Build and enhance real-time anti-fraud systems processing large-scale data. 
• Develop and optimize backend services, internal tools, and validation frameworks. 
• Contribute to distributed system components across multi-region cloud environments. 
• Use big-data technologies (Spark, Hadoop, ClickHouse, Yugabyte) to build scalable pipelines.

• Experience with MySQL and SQL optimization. 
• Basic system design skills (scalability, reliability, performance).

• Strong communication skills and a collaborative mindset. 
 Preferred Qualifications

• Familiarity with analytical/distributed databases (ClickHouse, YugabyteDB). 
• Exposure to big-data frameworks (Spark, Flink). 
• Basic understanding of ML concepts and modern AI/LLM tools.

• Ability to write automation scripts (Bash, Python).

• Hands-on experience in a dynamic and collaborative work environment. 
• Opportunity to work closely with experienced professionals in the field. 
• Exposure to real-world software testing scenarios. 
• Competitive hourly rate, range 20-25 CAD per hour.

Job Summary: 

 Job Description: 
 Are you interested in being a part of a company that has a positive social impact? Do you want to join a growing team with a modern engineering culture? 

 At BiblioCommons, we build SaaS solutions for public libraries that directly impact the lives of millions and foster learning, literacy and culture within the digital world. We are constantly improving our products through user research, client interaction, and the input of our creative staff. Join a team of passionate professionals making public libraries accessible, delightful, and engaging. 

 A lot of companies tout 'social impact', here at BiblioCommons we serve over 8 million diverse users each month by partnering with close to 200 public libraries in Canada, the US and New Zealand. Libraries are more than just book stacks; they are public spaces that foster learning, connection, and community and BiblioCommons is bringing that community online with clever software that powers the world's largest libraries. 

 Engineering @ BiblioCommons 

 BiblioCommons offers an opportunity to work in an environment that combines the challenges and complexity of a large-scale, data-intensive application with the creativity and fun of a sophisticated consumer web offering, central to the daily web interactions of millions of users. 

 We’re a highly collaborative team that applies innovative solutions to challenging problems. We believe strongly in automation and invest heavily in it. We’re also committed to doing things right and always looking for ways to do them better. Today, that means building an AI-first software development lifecycle, where engineers use agentic coding tools like Claude Code to plan, build, test, and review changes across our platform. 

 We are hiring two Junior Full-Stack Engineers for 16-month PEY internships to maintain and build elegant, high-performance web experiences that help millions of users discover more physical and digital content. You will work across the full stack, primarily through Claude Code: directing an AI agent to explore our codebase, write and refactor code, generate tests, and investigate issues, while you own the thinking, the judgment, and the quality of everything that ships. 

 By AI-native, we mean someone for whom working with AI agents is already the natural way to build software, and who understands the code well enough to own it. We care less about how fast you can prompt and more about how well you can direct, verify, and improve what an agent produces. 

 You will enjoy and be successful in this role if you are: 
 
• Great at debugging and not afraid to step out of your comfort zone. 
• Accountable and take ownership of your work, including every line of code an AI agent writes on your behalf. 
• Supportive and enjoy working as part of a team. 
• Passionate about self-improvement, growth, and tackling new challenges. 
• Reliable and consistent in the effort you bring. 
• Never content with the status quo. You are always looking to automate, improve processes, and follow best practices. 
• AI-native: AI agents are already your default way to learn, build, and solve problems, not an occasional experiment. 
• Healthily skeptical: you verify AI output instead of trusting it, and you can tell when an agent is confidently wrong. 
 How you will make an impact: 
 
• Enhance and maintain our platform applications, front end and back end, that serve millions of users, using Claude Code as your primary development tool. 
• Turn tickets into clear specs and plans before implementation, and use them to guide the agent through well-scoped, reviewable changes. 
• Debug and perform root cause analysis on integration issues, using AI to trace code paths, read logs, and test hypotheses quickly. 
• Review, test, and refine AI-generated code so that what you ship is clean, robust, performant, and secure. 
• Maintain quality as a priority by writing meaningful tests and validating them yourself. 
• Improve developer productivity by refactoring key areas of the Core UI codebase. 
• Contribute to our shared AI tooling, such as Claude Code custom commands, skills, and project context files, so the whole team gets faster. 
• Work across multiple frameworks and programming languages, using AI to ramp up quickly on unfamiliar parts of a large, mature codebase. 
• Communicate effectively to flag challenges or blockers to deliver on time. 
 What will you bring to the team: 
 
• Hands-on experience building software with AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or similar) through coursework, personal projects, hackathons, or previous internships. 
• Ability to break a problem into clear, well-scoped instructions and give an agent the context it needs to succeed. 
• Solid fundamentals in data structures and algorithms. You need to understand the code to judge it. 
• Knowledge of JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3. 
• Some knowledge of RESTful APIs and how web applications fit together, from browser to database. 
• Excellent problem-solving and debugging skills. 
• Excellent communication skills and collaboration across teams. 
• Passion and motivation to learn new technologies. 
• Interest in building highly responsive consumer web application interfaces at scale. 
 Bonus Points for: 
 
• React, Ruby, and Rails knowledge. 
• Previous programming experience in any object-oriented language. 
• Experience customizing AI coding workflows, such as custom commands, skills, subagents, hooks, or MCP server integrations. 
• A portfolio, GitHub repo, or short write-up showing something you built with an AI agent and what you learned about working with one. 
• Knowledge of cloud-native applications. 
• Basic computer networking knowledge (connectivity issues, LANs, firewalls, etc.). 
 Salary Range: 
 
• $50,000 - $65,000 

 Worker Type: 
Student (Fixed Term) (Trainee) 
 
 Number of Openings Available:     
0

About Vital Lyfe

Vital Lyfe is a tech company redefining water autonomy through innovation, creating a new category of personal water making technology built to scale where infrastructure can’t.

 

The Mission
We're looking for a Software Engineering Intern to help build the software behind a high-demand consumer hardware product. We're spinning up manufacturing from scratch, scaling fast, and the software you work on will directly affect how we build, track, and deliver thousands of units.

You'll work alongside senior engineers on the tools, data systems, and infrastructure that power our operations and help us scale.

What You'll Do
• Build and improve internal tools that give our engineering and operations teams real-time visibility into production and manufacturing workflows
• Write integrations and scripts that connect systems and keep data reliable across the company
• Design and maintain dashboards that help teams understand operational data and make better decisions
• Assist with backend and cloud infrastructure work as we continue scaling our services
• Debug issues, write tests, and ship improvements alongside senior engineers

What We're Looking For
• Strong programming fundamentals and comfort learning new systems quickly
• Experience with at least one modern programming language such as Python or TypeScript
• Interest in software that supports real-world products and operations
• Familiarity with APIs, web applications, or cloud-based systems
• Practical and curious, with a habit of taking ownership and following through
• Able to break down a problem, work through it, and know when to ask for help
• Excited to work in a fast-paced environment where software and hardware intersect

Nice to Have
• Experience supporting or contributing to live backend systems
• Background in building user-facing interfaces with React or a similar frontend framework
• Exposure to SQL, structured data formats, and dashboards or data visualization tools
• Familiarity with AWS or cloud infrastructure
• Interest in manufacturing, hardware-software integration, or IoT systems



Physical Job Requirements - Essential Functions
